The '''Calamari Project''' was a project that was initiated by the [[Destabilization]] branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], aiming to cause a war between the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]], to prevent the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] from supplying [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==History==
To carry out the project, a team of Destabilization Branch operatives were surgically-altered to give them the appearance of Mon Calamari, and the team infiltrated a [[Farium/Legends|farium]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Morjanssik Mine|operation]] near the city [[Morjanssik]] on Mon Calamari. There, the Imperials caused disruption to the mine's operations, which threatened to put the production of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] for the Alliance behind schedule, so the Rebel Alliance dispatched a team of agents to locate the saboteurs. In an attempt to thwart the Rebel's efforts, the Imperials arranged for a group of Quarren thugs to attack the Rebel agents in a [[Long Drink|local bar]]. The agents survived the attack and the Imperials [[Death/Legends|murdered]] [[Moren Chonk]], Morjanssik's [[Chief Manager]], and the Rebels were implicated as having killed him, causing a warrant to be issued for their arrest. The Rebels were arrested, but they soon escaped and made their way to the Morjanssik Mine, where they confronted and defeated the Imperial infiltrators, bringing the Calamari Project to an end.
